gen-gf-baloo-da-2-general-sans: Loud, tall lowercase leads in Baloo Da 2, while General Sans keeps its downstrokes plain, with no swell. Loudness up top, quiet pen pressure below: that gap is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-manrope: Manrope reads bright and open, every stroke one width. Baloo Da 2 is the louder one, with wide-set s terminals and lowercase standing nearly cap-tall, so shrinking it would waste that size.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-montserrat: Geometric Montserrat glides along on generous white space, while Baloo Da 2 above it stands bold, lowercase almost cap-tall. One shouts, one glides, and the page holds both without a fight.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-satoshi: Baloo Da 2 has wide-set s terminals and lowercase that stand almost cap-tall, which gives headings real shout. Satoshi does the quieter work, with single-weight strokes and a soaring x-height that keeps text open.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-switzer: Approachable Switzer draws tubular, wire-like letters whose c tips never creep toward touching, a quiet partner to Baloo Da 2. Up top, the lowercase stands almost cap-tall and loud.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-fs-asap: Towering lowercase, held open rather than curled shut, defines Baloo Paaji 2. Asap joins in with readable sans lettering, open-arced c forms and a body height near the capitals, so the two sit together easily.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Baloo Paaji 2 towers, with a huge lowercase body and letters held open rather than curled shut tight. Be Vietnam Pro does the quiet job: pencil-steady, high mean line.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-fs-epilogue: A towering lowercase gives Baloo Paaji 2 its commanding stance, letters held open instead of curled. Epilogue bends curvy, unclamped strokes like a paperclip, a monoline sans that never shifts weight.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-fs-fira-sans: Baloo Paaji 2 towers with a commanding lowercase, letters held open rather than curled shut. Fira Sans follows with plain sans lettering of constant width and generous x-height, a sturdy partner for that tall heading.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-fs-merriweather-san: Baloo Paaji 2 is all tower, a commanding display face with letters held open instead of curled shut. And Merriweather Sans makes words look sturdy and large, with an e whose eye opens clearly to the right.
